currentPublicArtifactsScope: SHA-256 and byte length of every artifact emitted alongside this file, with paths relative to the output directory; this file is excluded to avoid a self-referential digest.

publicProjection.numericEvidencePolicy: Counts, numeric scores, timing, result-byte metrics and attestation values come from private row summaries without regrading. Token totals aggregate only trials with recorded usage; missing usage and empty token populations remain null, never fabricated zeros. Devin family identity is normalized for grouping while the exact native model UID is retained.
publicProjection.sourceEvidenceScope: Private row directories (summary, manifests, per-trial terminal, observation, transcript and native session files, quarantined aborted slots) stay outside the repository; verification.json carries their digests and recomputed counts only.
